notes: 1.50.13: KNL Tiêu chuẩn bậc fixes. (1) Framework Version dropdown filtered out frameworks with knl_frameworks.status='inactive' (the 9 legacy frameworks retired by the earlier library cleanup, e.g. KNL_TRUONG_KHO_PHF_D5BF32) — filtered by the real status field, no hard-coded IDs; default first-load pick also skips inactive frameworks. (2) Restored Admin's ability to add/edit/delete a bậc on a version whose grade matrix was already saved — previously the +Thêm bậc / xóa buttons were only wired for the pre-save pendingNewGrades staging list and silently disappeared the moment a matrix had ANY saved grade definitions, leaving only per-cell M-level edits possible. pendingNewGrades is now the single always-editable working draft (cloned from saved grades, or from the dynamic B1..Bn suggestion when empty) for both new and already-saved versions; Save always submits this draft through the existing saveKnlGradeMatrix full-replace RPC (no new RPC/schema). Removing a bậc now asks for explicit confirmation before it can drop saved requirements on next Save. Kept the existing rule: default suggestion count always derives from the version's own active level columns (B1..Bn dynamically), never a fixed/hard-coded count.
